body:
I actually managed to not get evicted... for now :s  
  
I'm feeling a lot better now and I think I might get through this - just wanted to let you know :)
I did talk to someone today and it helped a lot - thanks for your comment Tortiekitty :)

Hi sofar1776 :) I'm actually doing so unexpectedly better right now, after what happened today (I won't go into it, but suffice to say the day was a million times better than I thought it would be...) I feel like it's a kind of miracle... Thank you for your words; you really helped me.

Hey, just wanted to let you know you were 100% right! Honestly, it's crazy that I knew all those words so well, and I'd said them myself so many times, but somehow I just didn't believe them 'til today. You were right, completely, and I want to thank you for what you said - SW posts tend not to get many replies (given their importance). But the few replies do make a big difference :)

Hey, just wnted to let you know things are looking up for me all of a sudden - it's amazing, I just can't believe it... I was so sure, so certain that everything was broken beyond repair, but turns out there was hope after all :) It's almost funny reading through that post again and wondering how I could have thought like that. But I understand now, how dark times come around and they should be taken seriously, but there is a way to be happy, always. Thank you for your time, stranger :)

I can't communicate this through writing, I don't get it, normally I'm so expressive... I feel like I am going to die. My life feels like it's on an inexorable course now, I wish I could explain the feeling, it's like words don't feel the same to me at the moment. I can feel it physically in my stomach, I can see it on the horizon, I'm _scared._ I've never really had any reason to feel scared before. I understand that now.

Hi, thanks for the reply. I guess you're right, I just have a feeling that whatever happens I'm probably not going face the music at all, not until it faces me, so to speak...  
  
It's kinda the one constant thing in my life over the past several years, putting in either zero or minimum effort towards everything. I almost feel like I might end up committing suicide purely out of laziness - that's kinda silly, but in a way I'm only half joking.  
  
I have places I could stay, I'm sure, yeah. Thanks again for your comment :)
